harsh field deployments.

to third-party cloud platforms or handled through AutoPi Cloud.

Can be combined with AutoPi Fleet Management for vehicle tracking, usage data and basic diagnostics.

### Core, Cloud and API integration

## Data logging platform for vehicles, equipment and machinery

Connect vehicle and machine data directly to business systems with a pipeline that starts on-device.
Configure can0/can1 channels, bitrate autodetect (Any passive, OBD active, J1939 active), pass/block
filters, DBC decoding and output handlers from AutoPi Cloud. Export raw and decoded streams in
formats including JSONL, CSV and MDF4, and route data to local storage or AWS S3.

AutoPi Core runs on Linux with SocketCAN, Python and SaltStack, while the Cloud API mirrors UI
capabilities for integration into your own backend and deployment workflows.

Data Monetization 

Take control of a growing asset
 

Cities and towns everywhere already possess extensive, valuable datasets, with increased amounts of
data being readily available through the deployment of smart technologies. Too many cities,
especially smaller ones, unknowingly overlook the value of this existing data resource or give it
away too easily.


Our team of data experts help communities to take control and monetize their data assets. After an
initial audit to create a clear revenue projection, we build a City Data Directory to support
improved interdepartmental collaboration.


Profitable transactions can then be negotiated with our buyer ecosystem to leverage the revenue
value of the city's data assets that continue to grow year after year.


[Learn More ][16]

Bridging the Digital Divide

The “Digital Divide” is the existing gap in public access to information and communication
technology (ICT).  Most ICT companies across the United States prefer to service more affluent
communities and neglect many rural areas, elderly citizens, and economically disadvantaged
neighborhoods which could benefit the most from ICT upgrades.


We are unique in our corporate commitment to investing in local communities to help eliminate this
Digital Divide.


We are proactively committed to increasing ethnic diversity and MBE/WBE/DBE participation on every
single project we implement – typically exceeding our clients’ goals.


We also work within the Opportunity Zone legislative program, designed to spur economic development
and job creation in distressed communities nationwide, to help maximize the impact of our projects.
 

[Contact Us ][17]
[computer_onlineclass_1200_2.jpg]
[Meeting]

Project Funding

Developing creative funding strategies is one of our core skill sets. We excel at finding financial
resources for our customers beyond typical lease/bond financing to maximize the size, scope, and
impact of our infrastructure improvements.

 

We have successfully negotiated utility rebate incentives, federal tax credits, and special
financing programs for previous clients, and we can provide the analytical and administrative
support necessary to customize a financing package with multiple components so our clients can
implement the projects they want in the most cost efficient manner possible.

## Our mission

How can we **achieve a post-scarcity world** that addresses long-standing problems such as hunger,
poverty, war, pollution and climate change, and sets a new stage for human social development? **By
utilizing science and technology **for the benefit of people and nature. And by **evolving our
outdated cities** into highly automated, interconnected systems with a closed-loop economy.

Implementation includes raising awareness, educating and creating the necessary demand in society,
as well as working on ways to establish research institutes and test sites, promote mass automation,
and use of AI to replace jobs and transform current production/consumption model.

To achieve our goals, we use the ideas first described by the famous futurist Jacque Fresco, which
he called Resource Based Economy, and was widely promoted by the organization The Venus Project
(until 2018) and a number of social movements and initiatives, including ours.

We are committed to the principles of openness, scientific approach, rational thinking and acting
independently of political influences and national boundaries.

## Let’s keep the direction

Jacque Fresco and The Venus Project gained worldwide recognition with a futuristic vision of a
future based on science and the latest technology that could become a reality. People all over the
world supported the ideas and organized movements, groups, organizations (like ours). All of this
created momentum and helped create a demand in society for these changes.

But since 2020s, thanks to the new directors, the ‘The Venus Project’ organization and its new
program deny the likelihood of achieving this, rewriting the new program on top with the same names,
undermine the credibility of science and medicine, prepare for an apocalypse based on conspiracy
theories of oil shortages, and talk about the need for a rollback in the way of life, the social
system, and even technology. Its build up now on scarcity and solution is a network of eco-villages,
and the salvation ark for some that will be their new planned city in the desert…

*— No, thanks. Let’s maintain the original direction set by Jacque Fresco and move on!*

## Is all lost?

It was naive to rely on one single organization for such a global undertaking, which has failed us
many times already. **Now we have to combine all our efforts and do everything as it should be done,
taking this responsibility upon ourselves .**

We have the direction, as well as the knowledge, we have quite feasible projects, many groups,
organizations and hundreds of groups and pages in social networks, as well as the necessary
[experience][20]: from organizing an international decentralized movement, promotion, publishing
books and working with the mass media, conducting interviews and creating media materials, to actual
projects and participating in official events.

We organized and negotiated the building of the city of the future with, then still alive, Jacque
Fresco – and there is still an influential group that wants to move in the proposed direction. Our
partner has already organized a high-level international experience exchange club for real players
in this field, and has plans to build new smart cities and develop this field to Jacques’ proposed
level.

**And this is just one of the possibilities!** We have every chance to do it the way it was needed.

With a modest budget, we are making a real difference.

### Hola! Soy Andrés Sevilla. 

Un chico normal, con una extraña afición.

Desde pequeño he sido un friki de la economía y los mercados. Con tan solo 9 años le quitaba a mi
padre el periódico para leer la sección de economía.

Con lo importante que es la educación financiera nunca entendí por qué hay tan poca información. Así
que en 2012, en mi último año de carrera, me propuse un objetivo claro:

**Hacer fácil la economía para que cualquiera la pueda entender.**

Creé Economipedia para que puedas encontrar cualquier concepto económico, guías de inversión y que
puedas formarte para gestionar tus finanzas y tus inversiones. Sin líos y sin humos. De forma clara
y profesional.

## Lo que nunca te enseñaron.

Después de trabajar durante años como asesor financiero en bancos como BBVA y habiendo alcanzado una
gran independencia financiera, en 2022 decidí dejar mi trabajo para centrarme en la divulgación
financiera y en la formación.

Se sumó al objetivo el gran Carlos Pareja, y junto con él y el resto del equipo que ves en la foto
hemos creado más de 50 cursos de finanzas e inversión.

[[Foto Equipo Economipedia Reducida 1]][25]

Desde entonces han pasado por Economipedia miles de alumnos y hemos probado decenas de formas de
enseñar.

Algunas funcionaron muy bien, y otras no tanto.

Pero todas nos han ayudado a afinar lo que de verdad importa: que sepas por dónde empezar a manejar
tu dinero, invirtiendo con claridad y sacando el máximo partido de tu dinero. Sin complicaciones.

Apúntate abajo y recibe un curso gratuito con las claves para empezar a invertir en bolsa con
cabeza.

#### Smart Building

It’s an undeniable fact that in recent years the term smart building has become very important. If
you are active in some kind of building, facility, security or safety management business, you’ll
notice the term passing your social media feeds all the time.

#### Smart City

Smart Cities are cities that use information technology or the famous 'Internet of Things' to enable
better management of their assets and more efficient governance. An inventive network of sensors and
web applications registers all kinds of data, which may or may not be processed automatically.

[ Learn more ][93]

#### Control Room

Our open integration platform Sky-Walker is mostly used in control rooms. We often get questions
about how control rooms work, and what they are. Even though we are only in charge of providing the
control room software, we do know everything about them. We're happy to share our expertise.

[ Learn more ][94]

# A propos de Mercuroo

### La société Mercuroo

Nous sommes une société de services indépendante spécialisée en **externalisation d'ingénierie
d'affaires à l'international et de management de contrat export pour les entreprises de la ville
intelligente et durable ou "smart sustainable city"***. 
Avec une expérience cumulée de plus de 30 ans et la réalisation de plus de 150 projets dans le monde
par notre équipe, notre jeune société vous accompagne dans votre développement commercial export et
dans l'exécution de vos contrats export dans le cadre de vos projets smart city.
L'ADN de notre équipe, **immédiatement opérationnelle,** au service de votre réussite et de celle de
vos Clients, se compose des 5 éléments fondamentaux pour mener à bien nos missions:
* **la connaissance technique** par l'expérience/formation
* **le savoir vendre** des produits et solutions
* **le savoir exécuter** des contrats
* **le savoir être flexible**
* **la connaissance** de l'environnement **international**
Nous intervenons auprès de collectivités, d'entreprises et de startups dans les secteurs de la ville
intelligente et durable à la française, des infrastructures de transports terrestres (rail et route)
et de l'ingénierie.

Une ville durable doit avoir une politique de réduction des émissions de Gaz à Effet de Serre (GES)
qui impacte toutes les parties prenantes de la ville. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés comme
**Expert Agréé GCI** auprès de notre partenaire [Global Climate Initiatives][11] pour calculer,
réduire et compenser vos émissions GES.

Nous sommes membre de l’OSCI, les Opérateurs Spécialistes du Commerce International. [L'OSCI][12]
est la fédération des entrepreneurs du commerce international. Elle regroupe les Sociétés
d’Accompagnement à l’International (SAI) et les Sociétés de Commerce International (SCI).

* Pour nous, la "smart sustainable city" est la ville inclusive, solidaire, durable, numérique,
connectée et intelligente. 

# Services

En tant que votre partenaire stratégique en ingénierie d'affaires, nous nous engageons à vous aider
à remporter vos contrats avec une efficacité optimale. Nous accompagnons également l'exécution de
ces contrats, renforçons vos équipes et vous impliquons dans la lutte contre le réchauffement
climatique. Avec un programme sur-mesure, nous travaillons main dans la main avec vous pour un
avenir prospère et durable.

DÉVELOPPEMENT COMMERCIAL

Nous sommes à vos côtés à chaque étape de votre développement commercial en France et à
l'international. Nous nous intégrons harmonieusement à vos équipes, fournissant tous les outils et
soutiens nécessaires à une mise en œuvre efficace et réussie de votre développement commercial en
garnissant votre carnet de commandes.
* Externalisation direction commercial export
* Stratégie commerciale et développement client
* Accompagnement de la prospection à la signature des contrats
* Réponse aux appels d'offres
* Gestion du CRM et du pipeline commercial
* Identification de partenaires
* Ouverture de nouveaux marchés
* Soutien lors de salons internationaux
* Management d'équipe commerciale
* Formation au développement export



Le développement commercial est réalisé par notre pôle

MANAGEMENT DE CONTRAT

Gagner un contrat à forte valeur ajoutée et le manager est complexe, particulièrement à
l'international. Cela nécessite un savoir faire et une exécution professionnelle sans faille. C'est
pourquoi nous intégrons vos équipes en apportant un soutien opérationnel, pour assurer une
réalisation impeccable du contrat.
* Externalisation direction opérationnelle export
* Exécution du contrat jusqu'à la fin de garantie
* Identification de sous traitants
* Coordination d'équipe projet multiculturelle et multidisciplinaire
* Soutien lors de réunion auprès de clients
* Négociation d'avenants
* Gestion de l'ERP et reporting
* Soutien à la rédaction des cahiers de recettes
* Management d'équipe projet
* Formation gestion de contrat export



Le management de contrat est réalisé par notre pôle

BILAN CARBONE / GES

Avec l'appui de notre partenaire Global Climate Initiatives, nous vous accompagnons dans la
réalisation de votre bilan GES (gaz à effet de serre), parmi d'autres services. Nous vous guidons
dans le calcul, la réduction et la compensation de vos émissions GES, affirmant ainsi votre
engagement envers l'environnement.
* Sensibilisation à la neutralité carbone
* Accompagnement bilan GES
* Calcul du bilan GES
* Identification réduction des émissions GES
* Soutien à la compensation des émissions GES
* Reporting bilan GES
* Soutien bilan GES
* Formation bilan GES







﻿


Le bilan carbone est réalisé par Mercuroo Expert Agréé GCI

# A propos de Mercuroo

### La société Mercuroo

Nous sommes une société de services indépendante spécialisée en **externalisation d'ingénierie
d'affaires à l'international et de management de contrat export pour les entreprises de la ville
intelligente et durable ou "smart sustainable city"***. 
Avec une expérience cumulée de plus de 30 ans et la réalisation de plus de 150 projets dans le monde
par notre équipe, notre jeune société vous accompagne dans votre développement commercial export et
dans l'exécution de vos contrats export dans le cadre de vos projets smart city.
L'ADN de notre équipe, **immédiatement opérationnelle,** au service de votre réussite et de celle de
vos Clients, se compose des 5 éléments fondamentaux pour mener à bien nos missions:
* **la connaissance technique** par l'expérience/formation
* **le savoir vendre** des produits et solutions
* **le savoir exécuter** des contrats
* **le savoir être flexible**
* **la connaissance** de l'environnement **international**
Nous intervenons auprès de collectivités, d'entreprises et de startups dans les secteurs de la ville
intelligente et durable à la française, des infrastructures de transports terrestres (rail et route)
et de l'ingénierie.

Une ville durable doit avoir une politique de réduction des émissions de Gaz à Effet de Serre (GES)
qui impacte toutes les parties prenantes de la ville. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés comme
**Expert Agréé GCI** auprès de notre partenaire [Global Climate Initiatives][11] pour calculer,
réduire et compenser vos émissions GES.

Nous sommes membre de l’OSCI, les Opérateurs Spécialistes du Commerce International. [L'OSCI][12]
est la fédération des entrepreneurs du commerce international. Elle regroupe les Sociétés
d’Accompagnement à l’International (SAI) et les Sociétés de Commerce International (SCI).

* Pour nous, la "smart sustainable city" est la ville inclusive, solidaire, durable, numérique,
connectée et intelligente.

En tant que votre partenaire stratégique en ingénierie d'affaires, nous nous engageons à vous aider

building, and 2D/3D animation, committed to delivering excellence in both strategy and creative
production. Our consulting team, composed of Harvard Business School and University of Tokyo
graduates, applies Big 3 (MBB) methodologies to help large organizations, including FORTUNE 500
companies, navigate growth, market entry, product strategy, and operational challenges. Alongside
consulting, our venture-building team drives innovation across eCommerce and HR solutions.

Expanding our offerings, we provide end-to-end animation services, including 2DCG and illustration
for manga, character design, and game/event visuals, 3-view diagrams and color design, 3DCG
production with planning and modeling, and illustrations for merchandise and multimedia content. By
combining strategic insight with creative expertise, we deliver solutions that drive growth,
engagement, and impact—making us a trusted partner for innovation and execution.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

# SensorGO

## La medida de la prevención

Monitoreo, prevención y Alertamiento 

### Soluciones para monitorear y disminuir riesgos

#### [Internet de las Cosas][17]

Diversas soluciones inalambricas basadas en Internet de las Cosas, con una amplia gama de parámetros
ambientales, de proceso y estructurales.

#### [Sistema de Alarma Sísmica][18]

SeismicAlert cuenta con 4 algoritmos de detección, incluyendo onda P; entrega el valor de intensidad
en el sitio sin depender de señales externas.

#### [Monitoreo de Salud Estructural ][19]

Proveemos sistemas de monitoreo de Salud estructural para tomar decisiones operativas y evaluar la
integridad y seguridad de la estructura ante sismos.

#### [Monitoreo y desinfección de espacios][20]

Conoce la cantidad de CO2 en tus habitaciones y toma acciones preventivas.

#### [Alertamiento Masivo][21]

Tenemos soluciones de sistemas de advertencia, para notificaciones masivas a todas las industrias,
protección públicos y militares.

#### [Estaciones Meteorológicas][22]

Estaciones para medir y registrar regularmente diversas variables meteorológicas, en el sector de
construcción, energía y otros.

#### [Electricidad][23]

Medidores completamente equipados con opción de modulo LoRa y lectores ópticos altamente compatibles
con casi todos los medidores.

#### [Telemetría][24]

Conoce los radios, routers y concentradores ideales para tus aplicaciones en telecomunicaciones.

# SensorGO

## La medida de la prevención

Monitoreo, prevención y Alertamiento 

### Soluciones para monitorear y disminuir riesgos

#### [Internet de las Cosas][17]

Diversas soluciones inalambricas basadas en Internet de las Cosas, con una amplia gama de parámetros
ambientales, de proceso y estructurales.

#### [Sistema de Alarma Sísmica][18]

SeismicAlert cuenta con 4 algoritmos de detección, incluyendo onda P; entrega el valor de intensidad
en el sitio sin depender de señales externas.

#### [Monitoreo de Salud Estructural ][19]

Proveemos sistemas de monitoreo de Salud estructural para tomar decisiones operativas y evaluar la
integridad y seguridad de la estructura ante sismos.

#### [Monitoreo y desinfección de espacios][20]

Conoce la cantidad de CO2 en tus habitaciones y toma acciones preventivas.

#### [Alertamiento Masivo][21]

Tenemos soluciones de sistemas de advertencia, para notificaciones masivas a todas las industrias,
protección públicos y militares.

#### [Estaciones Meteorológicas][22]

Estaciones para medir y registrar regularmente diversas variables meteorológicas, en el sector de
construcción, energía y otros.

#### [Electricidad][23]

Medidores completamente equipados con opción de modulo LoRa y lectores ópticos altamente compatibles
con casi todos los medidores.

#### [Telemetría][24]

Conoce los radios, routers y concentradores ideales para tus aplicaciones en telecomunicaciones.

Smart Future Cities India Expo

For the past decade, the Smart Future Cities India expo has endeavoured to build a better future by
showcasing innovation & sustainability. The Smart Future Cities India expo integrates technology
with the key pillars of urban development for optimising resources and making cities smart and
sustainable. The 2026 expo will be a hub for future technologies, with a special focus on Robotics,
Automation, Drones, Cyber Security, Urban Innovation, Smart Mobility, Smart ICT, Greentech and ESG.

The expo will showcase India’s emerging role as a leader in technology and a force for good in the
world. As always, the expo will serve to amplify opportunities and provide a platform to engage with
leaders from government and industry to chart a course for the future. The 2026 expo will focus on
connecting smart city solution providers with senior government officials, industry leaders, Smart
City CEOs, city planners, Mayors, Ambassadors and stakeholders from India and around the globe.

showcasing innovation & sustainability. The Smart Future Cities India expo integrates technology
with the key pillars of urban development for optimising resources and making cities smart and
sustainable. The 2026 expo will be a hub for future technologies, with a special focus on Robotics,
Automation, Drones, Cyber Security, Urban Innovation, Smart Mobility, Smart ICT, Greentech and ESG.

world. As always, the expo will serve to amplify opportunities and provide a platform to engage with
leaders from government and industry to chart a course for the future. The 2026 expo will focus on
connecting smart city solution providers with senior government officials, industry leaders, Smart
City CEOs, city planners, Mayors, Ambassadors and stakeholders from India and around the globe.

### Creating a Medical, Wearable, or IoT Device?

Since 1979, Voler Systems has been committed to excellence in electronics product design,
specializing in wearable and IoT devices for companies of all sizes that are creating medical and
consumer products. Our engineers have deep knowledge about sensors, wireless communication, power
management for battery-operated devices, and medical devices. This expertise includes AI-enabled
electronics design and AI-based electronic design.

We work closely with you to ensure that every aspect of the design process, from the initial concept
to the final product, is handled with precision and care.

Whether you need an electronic design for medical devices, wearables, or consumer products, our
experienced engineers are here to help you achieve success, mitigating technical risk and making
your product easy to manufacture through forward-looking, AI-ready engineering development that
supports long-term innovation.

electronic design teams specializing in medical IoT and wearable medical technology to develop their
products. Voler Systems has developed hundreds of medical devices up to class III, including

## IoT Solutions

Wireless solutions by WAVIoT are based on the NB-Fi technology that supports secure bidirectional
communication for the Internet of Things (IoT), machine-to-machine (M2M), Smart Grid, Smart
Utilities, Smart City and industrial applications.

WAVIoT base stations and NB-Fi Transceivers with best-in-class receiver sensitivity enable the use
of all advantages of the NB-Fi technology at the same time: long range of bidirectional data
transmission, low power consumption and high scalability and stability of IoT networks.

NB-Fi base stations and devices allow fast deployment of IoT applications and provide the protection
of confidentiality and integrity of transmitted data by strong encryption algorithms.

## Our technology

**NB-Fi** is an LPWAN-class wireless communication technology developed by WAVIoT, which provides
long range communication between devices, both in remote areas and in dense urban environments.
**NB-Fi** technology is at the heart of all our wireless solutions.

NB-Fi is an open standard with a disclosed format of NB-Fi messages and technical data required to
produce compatible IoT devices. NB-Fi can be used in various countries, operating in the unlicensed
frequency ranges (ISM radio bands). The NB-Fi Transceiver supports data transfer rate from 50 to
25,600 bit/s.
